description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a button.
overview:
Dropdown menu wraps the Base UI Menu. The `DropdownMenu` root manages the open state and `DropdownMenuTrigger` opens it. `DropdownMenuContent` renders the menu in a portal, positioned below the trigger. Inside it, use `DropdownMenuItem` for actions, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` for toggles, and `DropdownMenuRadioGroup` with `DropdownMenuRadioItem` for a single choice. Organize items with `DropdownMenuGroup`, `DropdownMenuLabel` and `DropdownMenuSeparator`, and nest a submenu with `DropdownMenuSub`, `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` and `DropdownMenuSubContent`. `DropdownMenuShortcut` displays a keyboard shortcut at the end of an item.

Use a dropdown menu for actions and settings behind a visible button. For actions on an object opened with a right-click, use a context menu; to choose a value for a form field, use a select.
usage:
The menu is uncontrolled by default; set `defaultOpen` to start open, or control it with `open` and `onOpenChange`. Render the trigger as another component, such as a `Button`, with the `render` prop. Selecting an item closes the menu.

Checkbox items are uncontrolled with `defaultChecked`, or controlled with `checked` and `onCheckedChange`. Radio groups take `defaultValue`, or `value` and `onValueChange`, and each radio item needs a `value`. Set `inset` on items and labels without an icon to align their text with items that have one, and set `variant="destructive"` on items that delete or remove something.

examples.Checkboxes: Controlled checkbox items that toggle interface elements, including a disabled item.
examples.RadioGroup: A controlled radio group for choosing a single panel position.
examples.Inset: A labelled group of inset items without icons, each with a keyboard shortcut.

parts.DropdownMenu: The root that manages the menu's open state.
parts.DropdownMenuPortal: Renders its children into a portal outside the current DOM hierarchy.
parts.DropdownMenuTrigger: The button that opens the menu.
parts.DropdownMenuContent: The menu panel, rendered in a portal and positioned relative to the trigger.
parts.DropdownMenuLabel: A heading for a group of items.
parts.DropdownMenuSub: The root of a nested submenu.
parts.DropdownMenuSubTrigger: The item that opens a submenu, shown with a trailing caret.
parts.DropdownMenuSubContent: The panel of a submenu, opened beside its trigger.
parts.DropdownMenuCheckboxItem: An item that toggles a setting on or off and shows a check mark when on.
parts.DropdownMenuRadioGroup: Groups radio items so that only one can be selected.
parts.DropdownMenuRadioItem: An item in a radio group that shows a check mark when selected.
parts.DropdownMenuSeparator: A divider between groups of items.
parts.DropdownMenuShortcut: Displays a keyboard shortcut at the end of an item.

DropdownMenuLabel.inset: Adds leading padding so the label aligns with items that have an icon or indicator.

DropdownMenuItem.inset: Adds leading padding so the item aligns with items that have an icon or indicator.
DropdownMenuItem.variant: `destructive` colors the item and its icon with the `danger` color.

DropdownMenuSubTrigger.inset: Adds leading padding so the trigger aligns with items that have an icon or indicator.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.inset: Adds leading padding so the item aligns with other inset items.

DropdownMenuRadioItem.inset: Adds leading padding so the item aligns with other inset items.

DropdownMenuShortcut.mod: Prefixes the shortcut with the platform modifier key, `⌘` on Apple platforms and `Ctrl+` elsewhere.

accessibility:
- The trigger sets `aria-expanded`. The menu has the `menu` role; items have the `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio` role, and checkbox and radio items set `aria-checked`.
- Groups have the `group` role and take their name from `DropdownMenuLabel`.
- Opening the menu from the keyboard focuses the first item. Arrow keys move between items, and disabled items set `aria-disabled`.
- On a submenu trigger, the Right Arrow opens the submenu and moves focus into it, and the Left Arrow returns to the trigger. The arrow directions follow the reading direction.
- Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.
- `DropdownMenuShortcut` only displays a shortcut; it does not register one. It is hidden on small screens.
notes:
- Styling hooks: `data-slot` values such as `dropdown-menu-content`, `dropdown-menu-item`, `dropdown-menu-checkbox-item`, `dropdown-menu-checkbox-item-indicator`, `dropdown-menu-radio-item`, `dropdown-menu-radio-item-indicator`, `dropdown-menu-sub-trigger`, `dropdown-menu-label`, `dropdown-menu-separator` and `dropdown-menu-shortcut`.
- Items set `data-inset` and `data-variant`; disabled items get `data-disabled`, and an open submenu trigger gets `data-popup-open`.
- By default the menu opens below the trigger, aligned to `start`, and matches the trigger's width with a minimum of `12rem`. Override the width with `className`.
- Uses the `surface-raised`, `item-hover`, `item-selected`, `danger`, `danger-surface` and `separator` tokens.
